shortDescription: Information module for Sda Anycast Gateways Count

options.name: dnac_debug
options.description: Flag for Cisco DNA Center SDK to enable debugging.

options.name: dnac_password
options.description: The Cisco DNA Center password to authenticate.

options.name: dnac_username
options.description: The Cisco DNA Center username to authenticate.

options.name: dnac_verify
options.description: Flag to enable or disable SSL certificate verification.

options.name: dnac_version
options.description: Informs the SDK which version of Cisco DNA Center to use.

options.name: fabricId
options.description: FabricId query parameter. ID of the fabric the anycast gateway is assigned to.

options.name: ipPoolName
options.description: IpPoolName query parameter. Name of the IP pool associated with the anycast gateways.

options.name: validate_response_schema
options.description: Flag for Cisco DNA Center SDK to enable the validation of request bodies against a JSON schema.

options.name: virtualNetworkName
options.description: VirtualNetworkName query parameter. Name of the virtual network associated with the anycast gateways.

options.name: vlanId
options.description: VlanId query parameter. VLAN ID of the anycast gateways. The allowed range for vlanId is 2-4093 except for reserved VLANs 1002-1005, 2046, and 4094.

options.name: vlanName
options.description: VlanName query parameter. VLAN name of the anycast gateways.
